# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

**Best overall under $200: JBL Live 780NC.** RTINGS ranks it the best ANC pair under $200 it has tested, saying its noise cancelling competes with flagships from Sony and Bose. The results didn't include a current price, so check it at Amazon, Best Buy or Walmart via [RTINGS' list](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200).

**Best for battery and a current deal: Soundcore Space One Pro, $199.99 list.**
- It has a 40-hour battery with ANC on, LDAC support, and a foldable design.
- Tom's Guide names it best under $200 ([Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)).
- A deal site reports that code AFSC20 took $39.99 off in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, bringing it to about $160. The code is valid through 2026-12-31 but excludes items already on sale ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-space-one-pro)).
- [Buy at Soundcore's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you. Checkout has the final say on the code and price.
- It has no IP rating. The newer Space 2 Pro costs the same but lists only 30 hours of ANC battery.

**Best value: Soundcore Space Q45, about $100.** RTINGS calls it the best headphones under $200 overall and the best budget ANC pair. It has strong noise isolation and nearly 28 hours of battery with ANC on ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)). Prices were listed at Amazon and Walmart.

**Other options**
- **Soundcore Space One, about $100:** It supports LDAC, which only helps if you have an Android phone. SoundGuys measured about 43 hours of battery ([RatingMobile summary](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)).
- **JLab JBuds Lux ANC, about $80:** It has a 44-hour battery but the weakest ANC of the group, which is fine for buses and offices but less so for planes ([RatingMobile](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)).
- **Sony WH-CH730N, about $176–178:** It has good sound, ANC and comfort, but Tom's Guide thinks the US price is too high ([Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)).

**My pick:** For the best ANC, go with the JBL Live 780NC. For long battery life at a sale price, get the Space One Pro. If you want to spend less, the Space Q45 gets you most of the way for about $100. Prices change often, so confirm at checkout.
